greeting: Zeke. My guy. Birthday sigma himself.
Koh's house is officially the first stop, so no pressure, but this run is being judged.
beforeGame: Five letters, six tries, three words. I've seen you type. Lock in.
win: Okay that was clean. You cooked, no cap.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Run it back? Low key I want to see if that was luck.
lines.locked: Koh isn't home yet. He said something about a bagel.
lines.clue: Next up: Kian's house on Kingston Ave.

greeting: Zeke! You made it. That's a W already.
I built you a crossword. Seven by seven. It's giving newspaper, but for people with aura.
beforeGame: Every word is something you know. If you don't know it, that's a you problem. Don't sell.
win: Bro filled the whole grid. Certified.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Same puzzle, faster? Chat, is he going for the record?
lines.locked: Kian's door is locked. Probably still writing clues.
lines.clue: Next up: Ben's house on Parkside Dr.

greeting: Yo Zeke. Happy birthday. I have prepared a threat.
Waves. Lots of them. You, one blaster. Very fair. Very balanced.
beforeGame: Arrows move, space shoots. Don't crash out on wave three, everyone crashes out on wave three.
win: Every wave. He cleared every wave. I need a minute.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Again? Bet. The waves have been humbled and they want revenge.
lines.locked: Ben's not home. The blaster is charging, allegedly.
lines.clue: Next up: Kai's house on Bowles Pl. If he says Towonga, just nod.

greeting: Times in Towonga, Zeke.
You know what that means. You've always known. Anyway, happy birthday.
beforeGame: Candle snake. Eat candles, grow, do not hit yourself. Simple game. Sigma game.
win: Times in Towonga. Fr fr. That's the highest honor I give out.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: One more? The snake said it's personal now.
lines.locked: Kai's out. The note on the door just says 'Towonga'.
lines.clue: Next up: Zubin's house on Grand Ave.

greeting: Zeke! Okay, listen, I threw a party and now I can't remember who brought what.
Four people, four times, four gifts. I have clues. I have a grid. I have a headache.
beforeGame: Logic puzzle. Mark the X's first, the O's find themselves. Low key this is my favorite kind of game and I'm not sorry.
win: You solved my whole party. That's genuinely goated.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Want the grid again? It's the same party. The guests are very patient.
lines.locked: Zubin isn't answering. Probably making another grid.
lines.clue: Next up: Xuan's house on Lake Ave.

greeting: Zeke! Birthday boy! Okay hear me out: rhythm game.
Four lanes, notes come down, you hit them on the beat. It's giving concert. It's giving aura.
beforeGame: Don't spam. Spamming is an L. Feel the beat and let it cook.
win: That was on beat. Like actually on beat. Ate.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Play it again? Same song, and this time I'm watching your hands.
lines.locked: Xuan's not home. You can hear the beat from the street, though.
lines.clue: Next up: Sammy L's house on Nace Ave.

greeting: Zeke. Sammy L. We have a situation.
Pizza boxes. Everywhere. They need to go on the marks and I can only push, never pull. Classic.
beforeGame: Three rooms. If you push a box into a corner it's cooked, and so are you. Lock in.
win: Every box on a mark. Zero boxes in corners. That's a sigma move.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: More boxes? Bet. Somehow there are always more boxes.
lines.locked: Sammy L's door won't open. Something's pushed against it.
lines.clue: Next up: Soli's house on Nace Ave.

greeting: Zeke! Happy birthday! I have a picture for you, but it's hidden in numbers.
Picross. The numbers say how many squares get filled in each row and column. That's it. That's the whole game.
beforeGame: Start with the big numbers, they give the most away. And don't guess. Guessing is mid.
win: You found the picture! Low key I forgot what it was, so thanks.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Another board? I've got one that's diabolical.
lines.locked: Soli's not in. There's graph paper taped to the window.

greeting: Zeke! Bro! Okay so the cake ingredients got scattered. Not my fault. Mostly.
They're all over the course. Jumps, pits, the usual. Grab enough and we're good.
beforeGame: Space jumps. Hold it longer to jump higher. The pits are real. Don't sell.
win: He got the ingredients AND made it look easy. Aura through the roof.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Run it again? I moved nothing. The pits were already diabolical.
lines.locked: Miles isn't home. There's flour on the doormat.
lines.clue: Next up: Sammy S's house on Manor Dr.

greeting: Zeke! Last house! You lock in for ten houses and THEN I hit you with trivia.
Lightning round. Questions about you and the people who know you. Any wrong answers are on them, not me.
beforeGame: Read fast, pick fast. No overthinking. Overthinking is how you lose aura.
win: He knows himself. Certified W. That's the last candle from us.
Here, take a candle for your cake.
replay: Again? Same questions. I'll pretend I don't know you've seen them.
lines.locked: Sammy S isn't home yet. He's writing questions about you, probably.
lines.clue: That's everyone. Head home for the last surprise!
